data.text:
Hazard likely in hidden Rack B.

Found:
- All sensors live, none flat/stuck.
- Trigger S3 +1.0C with rising S3/S1 trend. M1 dropped ~4.6 to 3.8kW ~45min ago but temps kept rising = heat not being removed.
- diagnose: vent_rackB blocked up to 86% onset ~125min ago, posterior 1.0, p_breach 0.88 in 90min, median 56.5min to limit. estimate_hidden_zones rackB 29.6C +/-2C, margin 5.4C - underestimates blocked-vent faults.

Done:
- warn notified.
- Tested: clear_vent rackB, backup_cooling, shed_load, power_cap 0.6/0.4, dispatch_human, cut_power B. All lower p_breach ~0.88 to ~0.4 but improve peak only ~0.2-0.3C on main variant.
- Requested clear_vent rackB - REFUSED by safety gate as NOT_ROBUST (needs >=1C under every variant).

Human next:
- Urgent physical check Rack B: blocked vent/filter/fan, hot spot, burning smell. Clear vent, restore airflow.
- If Rack B temp near 35C limit, power-cap or cut circuit B, then backup cooling.
- Do not rely on S1/S2/S3 alone - room mostly uninstrumented.
